summary: Reduce repeated launch overhead with an execution graph while making captured dependencies and changing inputs explicit.
outcomes: Explain graph construction, instantiation, replay and update.
Choose capture boundaries and handle supported dynamic inputs safely.
sequence: Measure a repeated sequence with many short operations.
Draw the dependency DAG independently of streams.
Capture or construct a graph and replay stable work.
Distinguish changing data from changing topology or addresses.
Compare startup, replay, memory and update costs.

visual.question: Which changes can this replay safely accept?
visual.interaction: Change values, shapes and dependencies; classify replay or rebuild needs.

practice.task: Capture a repeated pipeline and provide an uncaptured fallback.
practice.success: Outputs remain correct across supported input changes; compile/capture and steady-state costs are separate.
